run_PPO_training: run the PPO class to train a discrete action space agent using Proximal Policy Optimization
get_loss_PPO: get the PPO loss including critic loss, A2C loss, and entropy loss from trajectories
get_gae_PPO: compute Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) values from done signals, rewards, and critic outputs
create_PPO_instance: create a PPO instance with config, environment factories, and agent factory for discrete action spaces
review_PPO_run: review the PPO run method that manages training and evaluation batchers with RL_Batcher processes
